scope: Finite contributions at the named stock holding points. These values do not alone prove the complete memory bound, HTTP/2 or gRPC holding, in-progress frames, or process RSS. Rebind and review the source slice on every SDK release change.

assumptions.name: forward-response-queue
assumptions.reason: The stock ForwardTcp response queue awaits bounded-channel capacity before another response chunk is enqueued. Its queued contribution is capacity times maximum chunk bytes; account for active read/send frames separately.

assumptions.name: relay-queues
assumptions.reason: Both stock RelayStream directions use a bounded 16-frame output queue and a 16 KiB read buffer. Account for each endpoint queue and active read/send frames separately.

assumptions.name: gateway-pairing-buffer
assumptions.reason: The stock relay pairing uses one bounded Tokio duplex. Its capacity applies separately in each direction; it is not a limit on the complete relay or process.
